mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 4.5%) signals accommodative monetary policy, reducing discount rates and boosting equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 4.5%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate exceeding 5.0% (UNRATE > 5.0%) signals economic weakness, increasing recession risk and reducing corporate earnings growth, predicting negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE > 5.0%, or the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.5%) and high interest rates (FEDFUNDS > 5.0%) indicate restrictive monetary policy, suppressing corporate profits and equity valuations, predicting negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 3.5% AND FEDFUNDS > 5.0%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a housing market expansion regime (HOUST > 1500.0 and RSAFS > 370000.0), strong consumer spending and construction activity boost corporate revenues, predicting positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances during housing market expansion, or the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production level (INDPRO > 110.0) indicates robust manufacturing activity, supporting corporate earnings growth and predicting positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO > 110.0, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained high inflation rate (CPIAUCSL > 3.5%) signals potential central bank tightening, increasing real interest rates and reducing equity valuations, predicting negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 3.5%, or the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when PAYEMS < 137000.0 AND UNRATE > 4.6%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
